name: Elderly Disciple Holding a Censer (probably Kasyapa)
summary: Standing figure of an elderly Arhat facing proper right, holding a long-handled censer in both hands.  Low sandstone relief from cave 2 (south wall) at Tianlongshan, Shanxi province.
